summary: Frontend-only validation of the Chrome-Translate removeChild crash fix on /profile. All 6 requested scenarios pass: /profile loads cleanly, 'Lunghezza gamba' field present with no 'DOLCE'/'Cavallo' labels, save works and persists via API, anti-translate markup (html.translate='no', meta google=notranslate, #root.notranslate) present, remains intact after language switch, and /dashboard pricing cards + paywall modal work.
critical_code_review_comments: I18nProvider applies translate='no' only after render via useEffect; because index.html already sets it at parse time, this is fine. If i18n provider ever removes it, there is no guard — consider a MutationObserver fallback if a browser extension strips the attribute.
seed_data_creation: Wrote inseam_cm=78 to demo-fase1-user via /api/profile/measurements PUT during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profile page bug fully resolved. Anti-translate attributes verified: html[lang=it][translate=no], meta[name=google][content=notranslate], #root.notranslate. Lang switcher persists translate='no' after switching to EN. No removeChild/NotFoundError in console across /profile, /dashboard, and lang-switch flows. GET /api/profile/measurements returned inseam_cm=78 confirming persistence.
rca of the issue: Root cause was Chrome Google Translate mutating React-managed Italian text (translating 'Cavallo' label to 'DOLCE'), triggering removeChild in React reconciliation. Fix wraps whole document with notranslate (html.translate='no', meta google=notranslate, #root.notranslate, FIELDS wrapper translate='no' in Profile.jsx, plus runtime enforcement in I18nProvider). Verified: translate='no' attribute preserved across language changes, no runtime errors on /profile.
